mapper.select: SELECT id, questionnaire_id, content, type, options, sort_order, create_time, update_time FROM question WHERE questionnaire_id = #{questionnaireId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY sort_order ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO question (questionnaire_id, content, type, options, sort_order, create_time, update_time, deleted) VALUES (#{questionnaireId}, #{content}, #{type}, #{options}, #{sortOrder}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{deleted})
mapper.update: UPDATE question SET content = #{content}, type = #{type}, options = #{options}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE question SET deleted = 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE question SET deleted = 1 WHERE questionnaire_id = #{questionnaireId} AND deleted = 0
